Generated Narrative: CodeSystem v3-HL7DefinedRoseProperty

Language: en

Properties

This code system defines the following properties for its concepts

NameCodeURITypeDescription
Statusstatushttp://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#statuscodeDesignation of a concept's state. Normally is not populated unless the state is retired.

Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-HL7DefinedRoseProperty defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

CodeDisplayDefinitionStatus
ApplicationRoleI Application RoleHolds the unique identifier of an Application Role (stereotype of class).active
Cardinality Attribute CardinalityRecords the constraints on the cardinality of attributes as documented in the RIM and in MIMs.active
DeleteFromMIM MIM DeleteUsed in constructing a Message Information Model to indicate which attributes to omit from the MIM.active
DevelopingCommit Developing committeeHolds the id of the HL7 committee developing the model like "C00."active
DTsymbol Data type symbolHolds the symbol for a defined data type (stereotype of class).active
EndState End stateThe HL7 MDF says that leaf level use cases should be connected to a state transition of the subject class. The use case diagram provides the link to the subject class. The modeler must use three properties to identify the state transition -- this property and the two following ones named StartState and StateTransition. The first two are, as their names imply, the names of the starting state and ending state of the transition, and the third is the name of the transition.active
HMD HMD identifierThe identifier of the HMD from which the message structure for the message transferred by an interaction is drawn.active
ID IdentifierHolds the unique identifier of use cases, interactions and storyboards.active
InstancedDTsymbo Data type instantiatedHolds the data type assigned to the generic type parameter when an instantiation of generic type is recorded.active
IsPrimitiveDT Primitive data typeIndicates that a data type definition is for a primitive data type (stereotype of class).active
IsReferenceDT Reference data typeIndicates that the type for a data type component (attribute of a data type stereotype of class) is found by reference.active
IsSubjectClass Subject classSet true for classes that are subject classes.active
MandatoryInclusi MandatoryIndicates with a value of "True" whether the inclusion of an attribute in an HMD and in the messages derived from that HMD is mandatory. The default is not mandatory, and use of mandatory inclusion in the RIM is deprecated.active
MayRepeat Attribute may repeatIndicates with values of "True" or "False" whether an attribute may repeat in an HMD. The default is non-repeating.active
MIM_id MIM IdentifierUsed in a subject area category that holds a MIM. It provides the unique identifier for the MIM. The first portion of this identifier should be the ModelID of the RIM from which the MIM is derived.active
ModelDate Model dateA text version of the last modified date formatted like "19970606"active
ModelDescription Model descriptionContains the textual description of the model.active
ModelID Model identifierHolds the unique identifier assigned to this model.active
ModelName Model nameHolds the formal name for the modelactive
ModelVersion Model versionA text version of the version number like "V 30-08"active
MsgID Message type identifierThe identifier of the message structure within the HMD (above) that defines the message transferred by an interaction.active
Organization Developing organizationThis is the organization defining the model, "Health\_Level\_Seven"active
RcvResp Receiver responsibilityThis property holds the identifier of the follow-on interaction, when the receiving application role for an interaction has the responsibility to initiate a follow-on interaction.active
RespComm_id Responsible committee IDCaptures the identifier of the responsible committee for all subject areas and categories.active
StartState Start state(See description of EndState above).active
StateAttribute State attributeFor classes that are subject classes, this component provides the name of the state attribute for the class. Only one state attribute component may appear for a given class.active
StateTransition State transition(See description of EndState above.)active
V23_Datatype Version 2 data typeThis component can document the Version 2.3 datatype for an attribute that is related to or derived from data fields in HL7 Version 2.3.active
V23_Fields Version 2 Field referenceThis component provides a reference to the source Version 2.x field for an attribute that is related to or derived from data fields in HL7 Version 2.3 standard. Concatenate multiple values with commas, if multiple references to Version 2.x exist for an attribute.active
Vocab_domain Vocabulary domainCaptures the identifier (name) of the vocabulary domain that constrains the values of coded attributes. This property is captured both for RIM attributes and in MIMs.active
Vocab_strength Vocabulary strengthCaptures the strength of encoding for the elements of a coded attribute. This property is captured both for RIM attributes and in MIMs.active
zhxID History identifierThis component tracks the version history of each element of the model. It contains the unique element identifier assigned to each model element. The repository assigns values for this element. Modelers should not change these values or assign new ones, but they may copy them to indicate an element's historic predecessor.active
